common.note: “绿” means green; “绿的” describes something as green.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence focus: 红 can receive prominence as the corrected color.

common.note: “英文” means the English language.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence focus: 中文 can receive prominence in contrast with 英文.

common.sentence: 妹妹在看书，不是在写字。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence focus: 看书 can receive prominence as the corrected activity.

common.note: “红茶” means black tea.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence phrasing: the comma marks a natural boundary between the rejected drink and its correction.
Sentence phrasing: a brief pause after 妈妈 separates the addressee from the request.
Sentence phrasing: a pause after 这本书 sets the book apart before its owner is identified.

common.note: “洗手” means to wash one's hands; “再” introduces the next action.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Sentence phrasing: a brief pause at the comma separates the first instruction from the instruction that follows.
language_specific.usage_note: 先 marks the action to do first; 再 introduces the subsequent action.

common.note: “外面” means outside; “下雨” means it is raining; “带上” means to take something along.

language_specific.usage_note: 雨衣 is one noun for a raincoat; 衣 contributes the sense of clothing within the word.

common.note: “黑” means dark; “天黑了” says it has become dark. “打开” means to turn on here.

language_specific.usage_note: 电灯 is one noun for an electric light; 电 specifies the kind of lamp within the compound, rather than stating a separate action.

common.sentence: 我用手机给妈妈打电话。
common.note: “用” introduces the means used; “给” introduces the recipient. “打电话” means to make a phone call.

language_specific.usage_note: 手机 is the complete word for a mobile phone, not just a hand or a machine.
照片 is a noun naming a photograph, the resulting image, rather than the action of taking a photo. 张 is a common measure word for it.

common.note: “没听清” means did not hear clearly; “再” means again, and “遍” counts a complete repetition.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is realized as yí before fourth-tone 遍.
language_specific.usage_note: Use this chunk to request a repetition; 请 makes the request polite.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is realized as yì before third-tone 点.
language_specific.usage_note: After 说, this asks someone to speak more slowly.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 么 and 思 are neutral-tone syllables in 什么 and 意思.
language_specific.usage_note: Use 是什么意思 to ask what a word or expression means.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 吗 is a neutral-tone question particle.
language_specific.usage_note: Use 对吗 after a statement to check that you heard or understood it correctly.
